topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this, I just found out someone tattooed their body with my drawing. My drawing! I don't even know how they got it, do you think they even thought about me when they did it? What if everyone starts thinking it's their idea, my work turned into their skin? I need to find this person, talk to them, understand. And what if they didn't do it right, what if my art looks wrong on someone's skin, I can't handle that. This is too much, I don't know what to do, but I can't just sit here. I have to do something, right?
